content:
A reliable tipster has shared a short video that appears to show two new iPhone 18 Pro color options on display in a retail store.

The video is short, showing the expected deep cherry and blue colors, but it's almost certainly fake…

In the 14-second clip, someone is holding a deep cherry iPhone 18 Pro Max, with a dark blue iPhone 17 Pro Max placed next to it for comparison. We can also see a light blue model displayed on a stand.

The setting looks like a retail store. Macworld believes the footage could be real.

However, I'm much more skeptical.

My colleague Fernando Silva recently attended the IFA trade show and said that nearly every case manufacturer there had near-perfect dummy units, making it very easy to obtain such samples. I also find the setting suspicious—the display table is too small for a store, the product labels are carelessly placed and tilted, and there's no proper store interior visible in the background.

Finally, although this tipster has had a decent track record in the past, recently they've only been aggregating posts from Chinese social media.
